jobs.title: Implementation & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
About Ardovia

Ardovia is an all-in-one platform for pool builders and construction companies, covering leads, proposals and pricing, scheduling, job costing, purchasing, and the field mobile app. Demand is growing fast, and we need someone to own getting new customers live and successful.

The role

You take a new customer from signed to fully running on Ardovia. You configure their account, bring their data in, train their team, and stay with them until the software is part of their daily work. You are the first hire dedicated to this, so you will also build the playbook.

What you'll do

* Lead kickoff calls and build an onboarding plan for each new customer

* Configure accounts: locations, users and roles, pricing templates, schedule templates, document templates, and settings

* Import customer data such as price books, jobs, leads, and vendors, and check that it is accurate

* Set up integrations for email and calendar, accounting, distributors, and e-signature

* Run live training for owners, office staff, salespeople, and field crews, on web and mobile

* Be the customer's main contact for the first 60 to 90 days, then hand off a healthy account

* Build repeatable assets: checklists, training videos, help articles, and course content

* Bring customer feedback and recurring friction to the product team

What we're looking for

* 2+ years in software onboarding, implementation, training, or customer success, or equivalent experience running operations at a builder or contractor

* Clear, patient teaching, whether the audience is an owner or a crew lead on a phone

* Comfort with spreadsheets and data cleanup; imports don't scare you

* Organization to run many onboardings at once without dropping any

* Self-direction; you can build process where none exists

Nice to have

* Pool, construction, or field-service industry experience

* Experience with estimating, job costing, or construction scheduling

* Spanish or Portuguese

* Experience recording training videos or writing help documentation

Compensation

$69,000 to $83,000 base salary, depending on experience. Full-time, work from home, United States.

To stand out

Include a link to a 2 to 3 minute screen recording of you teaching any piece of software you know well.

Pay: $69,000.00 - $83,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

Security Implementation Engineer
================================

**Location:** Remote (United States)  
**Reporting to:** Director of Cybersecurity  
  
At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.  
  
**Overview**  
We are seeking a hands-on Security Implementation Engineer to design, deploy, integrate, and operationalize security controls for STN One customers and internal environments. This is an ownership role: you will translate requirements into working deployments, validate telemetry and enforcement, resolve difficult integration issues, and hand solutions over with the documentation and controls required to operate them safely.  

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

**Security Solution Implementation & Deployment**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of SIEM, endpoint protection, and segmentation solutions, from discovery and architecture through production rollout, validation, and handoff.
* Configure and integrate platforms such as Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM/XDR, SentinelOne, and Illumio, including management policies, sensors/agents, connectors, and API-based integrations.
* Onboard and normalize relevant log sources (identity, endpoint, firewall, cloud, server, network); verify coverage, parsing, timestamps, data quality, and alert routing.
* Design deployment patterns for Windows, Linux, and hybrid/cloud workloads while accounting for connectivity, access permissions, change windows, scalability, and rollback.

**Security Platform Integration & Operational Readiness**

* Integrate Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, GlobalProtect, Cloudflare security services, Okta/Microsoft Entra ID, and infrastructure monitoring sources as required by approved solution designs.
* Partner with the security operations team to verify telemetry delivery to XSIAM, detection rules, case routing, segmentation policies, and post-deployment monitoring readiness.
* Collaborate with customer infrastructure, IAM, networking, and SOC teams to establish effective policies, telemetry, detections, and operational ownership.

**Technical Troubleshooting & Security Controls**

* Troubleshoot complex agent health, data collection, authentication, networking, and performance issues without compromising production availability.
* Apply secure configuration, least-privilege access, secrets management, and tenant isolation to each customer implementation.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Produce implementation plans, architecture diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, administrator guidance, and acceptance criteria; conduct knowledge transfer.
* Improve reusable deployment standards, automation, templates, and quality gates across customers and internal STN initiatives.

Experience & Qualifications
---------------------------

**Required**

* 5+ years of hands-on cybersecurity engineering, systems integration, or security-platform implementation experience, including ownership of production deployments.
* Practical implementation experience with at least two of the following: enterprise SIEM/XDR, EDR, SOAR, or micro segmentation; ability to go deep on at least one platform.
* Strong Windows/Linux administration, networking (DNS, routing, TLS, proxies, firewalls), IAM, and API troubleshooting skills.
* Experience designing log onboarding, parsing/normalization, endpoint rollouts, or segmentation policy validation in customer environments.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, write clear implementation documentation, manage deployment risk, and communicate directly with customer stakeholders.
* At least one current security-platform certification relevant to the role, such as a Palo Alto Networks Cortex or network-security certification, Microsoft SC-200, or a comparable vendor-recognized SIEM/EDR/segmentation credential.

**Preferred**

* Direct implementation experience with Cortex XSIAM, SentinelOne, and/or Illumio in managed, multi-tenant environments.
* Python or PowerShell scripting; infrastructure-as-code, API automation, and configuration testing.
* Experience with Azure/AWS data sources, distributed networks, deployment change controls, and SOC operational readiness.

Compensation
------------

Benefits
--------

* Health Coverage – Medical, Dental & Vision
* FSA Health and Dependent Care available
* 401(k) Plan

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. * History of supporting small business customers directly
* Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
* Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity

**Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers):**

* Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
* Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
* Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time

Fire Prevention is one of First Due's most configuration-intensive modules. Integration Implementation Consultant, Connectors

**Location:** United States (Remote / US-Based)  
**Job Type:** Contract  
**Experience:** 10+ Years

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Integration Implementation Consultant** to lead the deployment and implementation of data connectors that integrate customer systems with cloud-based public safety and analytics platforms. This role serves as the primary technical liaison throughout the implementation lifecycle, managing customer engagements from requirements gathering and discovery through installation, validation, user acceptance, and production go-live.

The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of data integration expertise, technical troubleshooting skills, customer-facing consulting experience, and a structured approach to project delivery. You will collaborate with customer IT teams, software vendors, product teams, and engineering stakeholders to ensure reliable, high-quality data integrations that support mission-critical business operations.

Key Responsibilities Implementation & Project Delivery

* Lead end-to-end implementation projects for data connectors and integration solutions.
* Manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of milestones and project objectives.
* Act as the primary point of contact throughout implementation and deployment activities.
* Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer environments, business requirements, data sources, and integration needs.
* Define implementation plans, schedules, risks, and dependencies.

Data Integration & Analysis

* Analyze customer source data from various formats including SQL databases, JSON, XML, CSV, and flat files.
* Validate data quality, completeness, accuracy, and consistency before integration.
* Map source-system data to target platform requirements and identify transformation needs.
* Verify data synchronization, field mappings, and business rules during implementation and testing activities.
* Assist customers in understanding data requirements and integration best practices.

Technical Configuration & Support

* Configure, install, and validate data connectors within customer environments.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues involving databases, APIs, secure file transfers, and network communications.
* Coordinate access credentials, permissions, and system configurations required for successful deployments.
* Monitor connector performance and data health throughout testing and post-deployment validation phases.
* Escalate complex technical issues while providing detailed documentation and reproduction steps.

Customer & Vendor Engagement

* Collaborate closely with customer IT teams and technical stakeholders throughout implementation.
* Coordinate with third-party software vendors to obtain specifications, integration documentation, and technical support.
* Provide technical guidance and consultation related to integration architecture and operational processes.
* Facilitate implementation meetings, status reviews, and customer acceptance activities.

Documentation & Process Improvement

* Develop implementation guides, configuration documentation, validation reports, and handoff packages.
* Maintain technical documentation for integration processes, connector configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Create reusable implementation templates, playbooks, and best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance implementation efficiency and scalability.

Required Qualifications Experience

* 10+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
  + Systems Integration
  + Technical Consulting
  + Implementation Services
  + Solution Engineering
  + Systems Engineering
  + Technical Project Delivery
  + Customer-Facing Technology Roles

Data & Database Skills

* Working knowledge of SQL with the ability to:
  + Execute existing queries
  + Validate query results
  + Apply filters and sorting
  + Modify simple query logic when needed
  + Investigate unexpected data outcomes
* Experience working with relational databases and data validation processes.
* Strong understanding of data mapping, transformation, and data quality verification.

Integration Technologies

* Experience supporting integrations using:
  + APIs (REST/SOAP)
  + File-based integrations
  + ETL processes
  + Data connectors
  + Secure file transfer protocols (SFTP/FTPS)
* Familiarity with system-to-system integrations between on-premises and cloud environments.

Technical Troubleshooting

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to diagnose issues across data sources, integration layers, network connections, and cloud platforms.
* Experience interpreting system logs, error messages, and data validation reports.
* Ability to follow data flow paths and identify root causes of integration issues.

Operating Systems & Tools

* Proficiency working in Windows-based environments.
* Familiarity with database management tools and data analysis utilities.
* Experience using project tracking and case management systems.

Customer-Facing Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Experience interacting directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage customer expectations while maintaining project timelines.
* Strong organization and stakeholder management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience implementing enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with data migration and integration projects.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, security protocols, and authentication methods.
* Exposure to public safety, government, healthcare, or mission-critical software environments.
* Experience working with Agile implementation and product teams.
* Familiarity with ticketing and support systems such as Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk.

Key Competencies

* Data Analysis & Validation
* Integration Architecture
* Technical Troubleshooting
* Customer Relationship Management
* Project Coordination
* Solution Delivery
* Root Cause Analysis
* Documentation & Knowledge Management
* Vendor Management
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

Success Measures

In this role, success will be measured by:

* On-time delivery of implementation projects.
* Successful deployment and validation of customer integrations.
* High customer satisfaction and adoption rates.
* Reduced implementation escalations and issue resolution time.
* Accurate and complete technical documentation.
* Consistent achievement of project milestones and customer acceptance criteria.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Solovis is a leading portfolio management and analytics platform helping institutional investors navigate today's complex global markets with clarity and confidence. Backed by Insight Partners, we're building the next chapter of growth by investing in people and product to raise the bar on quality and client outcomes. Our team is driven by culture and disciplined execution, humility, and curiosity - where AI is at the core of how we operate, innovate, and serve clients. At Solovis, you'll join a tech-forward, growth-minded team that believes in learning fast, thinking big, and delivering meaningful impact for asset owners worldwide. Our companies are not the largest or flashiest, but they are among the best-run software businesses creating value for customers and shareholders at an accelerated pace. To date, our team has built six platform companies, each culminating in multiple liquidity transactions with multi-billion-dollar valuations.

**About this role**
-------------------

As a Senior Implementation Consultant on our Professional Services team, you will own the client relationship throughout the implementation lifecycle. This role is suited for professionals who bring strong project management discipline, deep subject matter expertise, and the ability to guide clients through complex analytical and operational topics. You will project manage the engagement, coach clients through decision points, and provide guidance on best practices to keep the project on scope, on time, and on budget. You will also coach and develop the Implementation Associates on your project team, reviewing their work and supporting their growth.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end implementations for enterprise clients, including scope, data readiness, configuration, enablement, and handoff, with the rigor to keep status, risk, and next steps clear at every stage
* Build trusted-partner relationships with CIOs, COOs, investment staff, and operations and performance teams from kickoff, aligning each rollout to the outcomes the client selected Solovis to achieve
* Run persona-based rollouts and adoption playbooks from the first enablement session, using adoption signals to decide when a client is ready to transition to Client Success
* Lead data onboarding with clients, custodians, fund administrators, and data providers to map, validate, and load holdings, transactions, and private markets data, resolving issues before they delay
* Act as a change leader inside client organizations, identifying workflow gaps and challenging clients when needed so Solovis becomes part of how their teams work
* Hold third-party data and delivery partners accountable to volume, quality, and timelines, and turn delivery data into clear priorities and escalations
* Use adoption data and delivery metrics to spot at-risk rollouts early, such as delayed client data, low engagement, or misaligned stakeholders, and arrive with a recommendation and cross-functional plan
* Coordinate Sales, Client Success, Support, Product, and Engineering through implementation so clients experience one unified Solovis team
* Channel product feedback, defects, and strategic client needs to Product and Engineering with the specificity needed to act

### **Key qualities**

* 5+ years leading client-facing implementations, onboarding, or professional services engagements for enterprise SaaS clients
* Hands-on experience with data onboarding, including data mapping, migration, validation, and integrations
* Experience managing multiple concurrent implementations from kickoff through go-live

### **Skills**

* Structured, precise communication in writing and live, so stakeholders always know where things stand, what is at risk, and what you recommend
* Curiosity, coachability, and comfort adopting AI tools to work smarter, faster, and more analytically

### **Requirements**

* Experience with institutional investors such as endowments, foundations, pensions, OCIOs, or investment consultants (preferred)
* Implementation experience with portfolio management, performance, accounting, or private markets data platforms (preferred)
* Experience managing vendors or outsourced delivery teams (preferred)
* Experience mentoring or coaching implementation team members (preferred)
* PMP or similar certification (preferred)

jobs.title: Implementation Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world's health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient's request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.  
  
By joining Datavant today, you're stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

**What We're Looking For**

The Manager, Implementation Enablement serves as the Operations implementation lead within the Product-Technology-Operations (TPO) operating model. The role leads the Operations portion of implementation delivery across aggregator activation, client onboarding, system enhancements, operational initiatives, and cross-functional business change. The manager converts approved business needs into executable plans and ensures Operations requirements, business validation, operational readiness, rollout coordination, governance, and transition activities are completed.

The role directly leads and develops the Applications Analyst function. It coordinates delivery across teams but does not replace Product, Engineering, Client Success, Channel Relationship, or functional business ownership.

  

**What You Will Do**

* Implementation work moves from accepted scope through launch with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, decisions, and risks.
* Operations requirements and acceptance criteria are complete, testable, and understood by Product and Technology partners.
* Business validation and production validation provide reliable evidence of operational readiness.
* Applications Analysts receive role-relevant coaching, standards, workload direction, and career development.
* Launches transition into supported steady-state operations with defined ownership, documentation, monitoring, reporting, and escalation paths.
* Establish and continually improve implementation standards, processes, and governance to support consistent and scalable delivery across partners, onboarding initiatives, and operational changes.
* Lead planning and execution for aggregator activations, onboarding changes, system enhancements, releases, and major operational initiatives.
* Create and maintain scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, decisions, risks, target dates, success measures, and implementation status.
* Maintain risk, dependency, decision, action, and blocker registers; drive follow-up and escalate when leadership action is required.
* Prepare executive-ready implementation updates and conduct post-implementation outcome reviews and lessons learned.
* Establish, standardize, and continuously improve implementation processes, governance models, readiness criteria, and operational handoff frameworks to support scalable growth.
* Directly manage Senior Applications Analyst and Applications Analyst.
* Set priorities and capacity plans across onboarding, configuration, requirements, testing, production validation, release support, and improvement work.
* Establish analyst standards for requirements, test evidence, process documentation, configuration validation, meeting notes, and implementation tracking.
* Create development plans and coach analysts in business analysis, testing, facilitation, process design, implementation delivery, and technical-to-business translation.
* Lead discovery and translate business needs into process flows, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and operational impact assessments.
* Assign and review analyst-produced requirements before Product or Technology evaluation.
* Assess client, provider, workflow, support, reporting, configuration, and cross-client impacts.
* Partner with Product and Engineering while preserving their ownership of product decisions and technical design.
* Coordinate Operations business validation and client-lens scenarios.
* Ensure detailed functional testing is completed by appropriate business owners and subject-matter experts.
* Coordinate defect evidence, retesting, production validation, and readiness impact tracking.
* Ensure Operations testing responsibilities are planned and completed without assuming ownership of all testing.
* Confirm SOP, training, communication, support, reporting, monitoring, escalation, and accepted-risk readiness.
* Recommend Operations go-live approval to the Director of Operations.
* Lead implementation meetings and governance activities throughout the implementation lifecycle while partnering with the Channel Relationship Manager to provide continuity and context prior to transition to steady-state ownership.
* Coordinate operational rollout, go-live support, stabilization, and transition to steady-state ownership.
* Ensure relationship owners receive a complete handoff for ongoing partner or client management.

  

**What You Need to Succeed**

* 5+ years of experience in operations, implementation delivery, business analysis, client onboarding, project management, change enablement, or a related field.
* Experience leading cross-functional implementations involving business, product, technical, and client-facing teams.
* People leadership or formal coaching experience, including workload prioritization and employee development.
* Strong requirements, process mapping, acceptance criteria, UAT, business-validation, facilitation, and executive-communication skills.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or comparable business platforms; healthcare operations experience preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining clear ownership, documentation, follow-through, and escalation.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

**About the Role:**

The Implementation Specialist is the first line of contact for Ooma Enterprise. To successfully on-board a customer, you must be able to seamlessly coordinate project implementation activities with both external and internal stakeholders representing business and technical aspects, provide technical directions, troubleshoot technical issues which might arise and facilitate internal and external escalations where necessary.

**What You'll Do:**

* Customer-facing voice for Ooma Enterprise tasked with providing a consistent, prompt, and high-quality level of customer service to our customers
* Project manages and oversees the entire onboarding process including provisioning installation, and configuration of our product
* Guide new customers through an established onboarding process, equipping them to confidently and effectively use Ooma Enterprise products
* Troubleshoot and resolve and/or escalate customer technical issues when required
* Set customer expectations, communicate internally to ensure tasks are on schedule, and offer suggestions to mitigate risks to avoid delays
* Liaise with internal teams (Sales, Engineering etc.) to ensure projects are completed on time, to spec while leveraging opportunities to introduce new products/services

**Experience We're Looking For:**

* 2+ years Technical Customer Success or Implementation Specialist experience, with a strong preference in a SaaS or Customer Service Call Center environment
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DHCP, VPN)
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Hands-on experience with inside/house wiring, structured cabling, low-voltage wiring, telecom installations, or network cabling preferred
* Project and client management experience is an asset
* Strong analytical, problem solving and coordinating skills to solve problems and make decisions
* Ability to manage several concurrent tasks and switch priorities on the fly while maintaining a calm demeanor in a fast-paced environment
* Goal-oriented self-starter with a service-oriented mindset who can work independently as well as in a team environment
* Proven history of previous successes in a setting where minimal direction is provided
* Excellent time management, organizational, problem solving, and analytical skills
* Strong aptitude for technology and ability/desire to learn new software, including utilizing AI to improve day to day work

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. * Communicate confidently and clearly with maintenance managers and IT directors, including when the news is not good

If you want to be the person customers trust with their data and the technical health of their implementation, and help make data migration a strength of how Ultimo delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites around technical workshops, trial loads, and cutover.
